summary: First audit of the semantic-entropy-gated branching repo against GOLD_STANDARD.md. The pipeline is well-built and largely wired: faithful SDLG write-point detection, Algorithm-1 clustering plus connected/kernel variants, a single mutually-exclusive diversity-method switch, a matched-k vanilla resample driver, an unbiased Chen et al. diverse-pass@k + structurally-independent diversity metric, and a strong stage-test suite (R8.5). I found and fixed three real correctness/evidence-validity gaps this iteration: (1) the strategy-proposal arm LOGGED the tau gate but never ENFORCED it (always branched all clusters), so the R3.3 tau-sweep / adaptive-gate evidence would be corrupted versus the SDLG arm which does enforce it; (2) the metric loader counted the best-of 'primary' duplicate trajectory in the eval resolved-vector while dropping it from predictions, inflating matched-k n by 1 and biasing the Chen estimate; (3) R5.3 set-valued evidence (>=2 distinct PASSING patches) was not implemented and the R5.4 low-entropy flag used a hardcoded 0.5 cutoff inconsistent with the R5.2 median split. I also added the missing publication scaffolding (RESULTS.md with the full §0.1 conceptual spine, design choices, and an enumerated threats-to-validity section), a budget-fairness audit script (R6.3) that already shows on existing artifacts that 0 passing branches exceeded the 250-step baseline budget (max passing = 164), and a figure-regeneration script (R7.3). All 40 tests pass; metrics+figures run end-to-end on the real artifacts. gold_standard_met is FALSE: R6.3 per-arm token/compute accounting is not instrumented (litellm cost tracking is disabled), and the headline matched-k comparison has not been executed (a GPU/vLLM+SWE-bench run I cannot launch here). The wiring and correctness are proven; the executed numbers remain the gap.

issues_found.title: Strategy-proposal arm logged but did not ENFORCE the tau gate (always branched all clusters)
issues_found.rationale: SDLG arm returned early when entropy<=tau but the strategy arm returned all cluster reps regardless, so the R3.3 tau sweep and the adaptive-gate claim (§0.1/R1.5) would diverge between arms. Fixed: strategy arm now collapses to the single dominant cluster when entropy<=tau.

issues_found.title: Matched-k n inflated by the best-of 'primary' duplicate in load_eval
issues_found.rationale: load_predictions dropped 'primary' but load_eval kept it, so n was off by one (primary is a duplicate, not an independent trajectory), biasing the unbiased Chen estimate and preventing a trajectory_id join. Fixed both loaders + added set_valued_evidence join by id.

issues_found.title: R5.3 set-valued evidence unimplemented; R5.4 low-entropy flag used a hardcoded cutoff
issues_found.rationale: No detector for >=2 distinct PASSING patches (case-1 set-valued evidence). Added set_valued_evidence(); made the off-mode low_entropy flag use the same median/--entropy-split threshold as the stratification so the two analyses cannot disagree.

issues_found.title: No RESULTS.md / threats-to-validity writeup
issues_found.rationale: R6.4 (threats to validity) is a BLOCKER and the DONE bar requires the §0.1 framing stated as the conceptual spine. Created RESULTS.md with both, plus design choices and a wired table stub.

issues_found.title: Per-arm token/compute accounting not instrumented
issues_found.rationale: litellm cost tracking is disabled (cost_tracking ignore_errors, cost_limit 0); only step counts are captured. budget_audit.py reports the step distribution and the step_limit-asymmetry fairness check, but true token totals per arm require instrumenting the model calls — deferred to next iteration to avoid a risky change to the agent run loop.

issues_found.title: No checked-in figure script (R7.3)
issues_found.rationale: Tables were regenerable but figures were not. Added scripts/make_figures.py (headless Agg) consuming the compute_metrics JSON; smoke-tested + run on real artifacts.
